clues.label: Tagline
clues.value: “"If I could only have one food to eat for the rest of my life?" "That's easy. Pez. Cherry flavor Pez. No question about it."”

clues.label: Plot
clues.value: After learning that a boy their age has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four boys decide to go see the body. ▇▇▇, ▇▇▇, ▇▇▇, and ▇▇▇ encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, but they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.
